name: Dirty Daughters
source:
Dirty Daughters is a Slice of Life game made on RPG Maker about Mikasa and Ayumu, two girls whose father got sick. To save him, the sisters need 1kk yen to pay for his treatment before the 30th day. They will work hard to save him, each in her style. Can you help them, or will you prefer to turn them into sluts?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3109350/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Dirty Daughters是一款在RPG Maker上制作的Slice of Life游戏，讲述了Mikasa和Ayumu两个女孩的父亲生病的故事。为了救他，姐妹们需要在第30天之前支付1KK日元的治疗费用。他们将以她的风格努力拯救他。你能帮助他们，还是愿意把他们变成荡妇？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3109350/]Steam[/url]]
